name: Beginner stretching
notes: Gentle mobility for beginners. Short holds, easy breathing. One-sided stretches use two sets so you cover left and right.

activities.name: Easy stretch
activities.instructions: 30-second holds. For one-sided stretches, do both sides (two sets). Stop if anything pinches.

exercises.name: Upward salute
exercises.instructions: Reach the arms up and lengthen through the sides.

exercises.name: Chest opener
exercises.instructions: Open the arms wide or clasp behind the back. Soft knees.

exercises.name: Side lunge
exercises.instructions: Hold 30 seconds on the left, then swap to the right for set 2.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.instructions: Hold 30 seconds on the left, then swap to the right for set 2.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Sit the hips toward the heels and reach the arms forward.

exercises.name: Seated twist
exercises.instructions: Hold 30 seconds twisting left, then swap to the right for set 2.

activities.name: Easy stretch
activities.instructions: 30-second holds. For one-sided stretches, do both sides (two sets).

exercises.name: Toe touch
exercises.instructions: Soft knees. Fold forward only as far as comfortable.

exercises.name: Seated figure four
exercises.instructions: Hold 30 seconds with the left ankle crossed, then swap to the right for set 2.

exercises.name: Quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Hold 30 seconds on the left, then swap to the right for set 2. Hold a wall for balance.

exercises.name: Lying hamstring
exercises.instructions: Hold 30 seconds on the left leg, then swap to the right for set 2.

exercises.name: Reclined butterfly
exercises.instructions: Soles of the feet together, knees open. Soften the inner thighs.

exercises.name: Knees to chest
exercises.instructions: Hug both knees in and breathe into the lower back.

activities.name: Easy stretch
activities.instructions: A short Sunday reset. Keep every hold gentle.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, slowly round and arch the spine with the breath.

exercises.name: Downward dog
exercises.instructions: Hips high, soft knees. Pedal the feet if the legs feel tight.

exercises.name: Pigeon
exercises.instructions: Hold 30 seconds on the left, then swap to the right for set 2. Keep the hips level.

exercises.name: Spinal twist
exercises.instructions: Hold 30 seconds on the left, then swap to the right for set 2.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Sit the hips toward the heels and reach the arms forward.
